subject: Re: Greenfield Healthtech — service degradation, credit reconciliation & contract proposal
messages:
From: Asha Verma <asha@greenfield.health>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Cole <evan.cole@greenfield.health>, procurement@greenfield.health
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe impact this morning — request for credits and contract remediation

Rafael,

We had a significant production degradation affecting our inference pipelines between 08:45–11:20 PT today. Symptoms: sustained 500 errors on our v2/chat endpoint, average tail latency spiking from ~120ms to ~2.4s, and throughput drops (p50 p95 both degraded). This impacted two customer-facing features and triggered an outage for several accounts.

Please treat this as an urgent escalation. We need:
- Immediate explanation of root cause and mitigation steps.
- A formal incident report and timeline.
- A commercial remediation proposal (credits/discounts) and an amendment to the SLA to cover repeat incidents.

We are pausing our ramp plans for Q3 until commercial and technical remediation are in place. Procurement will need a formal proposal and PO-ready invoice.

Requesting an exec-level touchpoint today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Asha Verma
Head of Platform Reliability
Greenfield Healthtech

[Attachment referenced: sample customer error logs — forwarded to your SRE team]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Asha Verma <asha@greenfield.health>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe impact this morning — request for credits and contract remediation

Thanks for flagging this, Asha — I’m very sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Soojin (reliability lead) and Ben (your commercial lead) so we can move quickly.

Immediate next steps:
1) Soojin will ship an initial incident summary and mitigation actions by EOD PT.
2) We’ll prepare a formal incident report and a credit calculation for the impacted window by tomorrow morning.
3) Ben will work with Procurement to draft a PO-ready commercial remediation and propose contract wording for SLA amendment.

Can you confirm the most helpful outcome from your side — pro-rata credit for June, a one-time service credit, and/or a contractual amendment for future incidents? We’ll prepare options and a recommended path.

I’ll schedule an exec sync for tomorrow 08:00 PT unless you prefer another slot.

— Rafael
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, Asha Verma <asha@greenfield.health>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Initial incident summary — Greenfield Healthtech (08:45–11:20 PT, 2027-06-24)

Asha / Rafael / Ben,

Preliminary technical summary (high level):
- Impact window: 08:45:12–11:20:33 PT.
- Root cause (preliminary): an aggregation scheduling regression in our dynamic batching subsystem caused priority inversion under a traffic spike, and a fallback policy routed a subset of requests to a smaller model variant without sufficient KV cache warmup. This produced increased tail latency and elevated 500s as memory pressure triggered transient RPC failures.
- Metrics: mean error rate increased from 0.03% to 3.4% during peak; p95 latency rose from 210ms to ~2.1s; average throughput for Greenfield API keys dropped ~28%.

Mitigations applied within the window:
- Disabled the new batching heuristic at 09:15 PT which reduced 500s by ~65% by 09:45 PT.
- Warmed KV caches and pinned the model variant for Greenfield traffic at 10:05 PT; end-to-end latency returned toward baseline by 11:20 PT.

Planned follow-ups:
- Full RCA and timeline (deliverable: SLA_incident_report_Greenfield_2027-06-24.pdf) by EOD tomorrow.
- A permanent fix for the scheduler regression with a staged rollout and canary tests — ETA two weeks.

For commercial discussion: initial impact calculation attached (credit_calculation_GF-8421.xlsx). The affected token-count estimate is ~18M tokens during the impact window; our preliminary recommended commercial remedial includes a one-month credit equivalent to usage during the affected window plus a goodwill engineering credit (see attachment).

I’ll join the exec sync to walk through technical details.

— Soojin
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_incident_report_Greenfield_2027-06-24.pdf (draft)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Verma <asha@greenfield.health>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed commercial remediation & contract amendment (GF-8421)

Asha — thanks for taking the time on Friday. Based on Soojin’s preliminary calc and our commercial playbook, our recommended package to resolve this quickly and enable your Q3 ramp is:  

Option A (expedite):
- Pro-rata usage credit equal to impacted usage (approximately $28,400) applied to your July invoice.
- One-time engineering credit: up to 20 dedicated hours of Redwood SRE/eng support for integration hardening.
- Contract amendment: add a clause for accelerated remediation (24‑48 hour response + credit framework) for repeat incidents, plus a waiver for a month if the same class of regression reoccurs within 90 days.

Option B (conservative):
- 20% pro-rata credit for June (approximately $14,750).
- Engineering discount voucher ($8k value) redeemable over 3 months.

We recommend Option A given the impact and your stated ramp plans. If you accept, I’ll prepare a PO-ready commercial memo and send a DocuSign-ready amendment (proposed_contract_amendment_GF-8421.docx). We can also add a short-term SLA addendum that clarifies credit triggers and escalation points.

Proposed next step: 30‑minute exec call to sign off on the package and get Procurement a single-line item for PO. Rafael — can you confirm we have go/no-go from Legal for the amendment text? Marissa, can you prepare the invoice stub and a DocuSign link once Ben confirms?

— Ben
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_calculation_GF-8421.xlsx]

From: Asha Verma <asha@greenfield.health>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Cole <evan.cole@greenfield.health>, procurement@greenfield.health
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial remediation & contract amendment (GF-8421)

Ben / Rafael — thanks for the clear options. We’ll accept Option A and would like the engineering credit scheduled within the next 30 days to harden our integration before Q3. Procurement requests a single PO line with the credit applied and a DocuSign amendment rather than a multi-step negotiation.

Please send the formal remediation memo, the final incident report, and the DocuSign amendment (we’ll have Procurement and CTO sign). Also escalate to Finance for a priority invoice adjustment so we can close procurement this week.

Looking forward to the exec call — please include Legal and Finance on the invite.

— Asha
Head of Platform Reliability
Greenfield Healthtech
